 About The Team
 Embedded Engineering Capability: Empowering Innovation in the World of Embedded Software.
Join Accenture to shape a future looking Software-Defined Vehicle Platform that unifies Linux, Android, QNX, AUTOSAR & Adaptive AUTOSAR into one powerful developer ecosystem, sustaining innovation in ADAS and Infotainment , building safe, secure, and continuously upgradable vehicles .
 How You Will Make An Impact
 The Embedded Software Engineer is responsible for:
Acting as the technical leader responsible for the Yocto-based Linux platform architecture, ensuring scalability and long-term maintainability across embedded products.
Leading, owning, and evolving the embedded Linux platform architecture.
Driving BSP integration, board bring-up activities, kernel strategy, kernel configuration management, device tree architecture / deployment, and bootloader design.
Optimizing performance, boot time, footprint, and overall reliability, and platform security.
Act as the technical interface to silicon vendors and partners.
 What you need to succeed :
 Must Have:
Minimum 8 years of Embedded Linux experience
Extensive embedded Linux experience, includig Yocto
Linux kernel, U‑Boot, Device Tree
Proven experience with board bring‑up, kernel configuration, and device tree development/deployment
Strong knowledge of Linux kernel security features, system hardening, and security platform design.
Experience debugging kernel panics, driver related issues, and low-level system problems.
C/C++, shell scripting, system performance optimization
Platform debugging, root cause analysis, and technical leadership
 Nice to Have:
Multi‑product or multi‑SoC platform ownership
Security hardening and update strategies
Contributions to open‑source or Yocto/AOSP projects
Experience in automotive, industrial, or safety‑critical systems
